description: This Java source file defines the BooleanFlagControlPanel class, which is a UI component for toggling a boolean configuration property related to rusefi software. It provides a checkbox and methods to send commands and read sensor status.

classes.name: BooleanFlagControlPanel
classes.description: A Swing panel component that contains a checkbox to control and monitor a boolean property in rusefi configuration.

methods.name: BooleanFlagControlPanel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the panel with specified labels for the control and checkbox.

methods.name: getControl
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel component containing the checkbox and label.

methods.name: installCommand
methods.description: Sets up an action listener on the checkbox to send a command with a mode (ON/OFF) when toggled.

methods.name: installStatusReader
methods.description: Adds a sensor listener to update the checkbox state based on sensor value updates.
